name: runnir
description: Fill in the secrets and variables of Runnir's local GitHub Actions runs from Codex. You confirm every change in Runnir; values stay in your Mac's Keychain.

interface.shortDescription: Fill in the values of local GitHub Actions runs
interface.longDescription: Runnir runs GitHub Actions workflows on your Mac. With this plugin Codex lists the secrets and variables a workspace's local runs read and which are missing, and saves values into the Repository's set or an environment's after you confirm the change in Runnir. Needs Runnir in /Applications.
defaultPrompt: Set up the secrets and variables Runnir's local runs of this repository need.
